subject: Territory overlap: partner pipeline reconcile for StellarPay cluster
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: riley.chen@catalystworks.com, priya.r@novaconsult.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com, jonas.weber@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Territory overlap: partner pipeline reconcile for StellarPay cluster

Riley / Priya —

Thanks for the intro calls this week. A quick heads-up: StellarPay appears in both CatalystWorks' and Nova Consulting's mid-market pipelines for Q3. To avoid duplicate outreach and to determine a preferred partner for a co-sell motion, can each of you confirm the following by EOD Monday:

- Primary contact and last-touch date at StellarPay (name & title)
- Which capabilities you plan to lead (implementation, integration, ongoing managed services)
- Any signed MOU or LOI in place or outstanding commercial asks

I've attached a quick overlap matrix and a trimmed account CSV that highlights the accounts in question. Internal team (Marissa / Laura / Jonas) — please review and flag any contractual constraints (e.g., existing referrals, marketplace listing exclusivity) before we decide.

Proposed options: 1) assign primary partner (co-sell with named partner for Redwood leads), 2) enable dual-engagement with delineated scope, or 3) hand over to Redwood field rep and pause partner outreach.

Next steps: Collect inputs, sync with StellarPay AM if needed, land assignment by Wed 8/4.

Thanks —
Priyom
Senior Alliance Manager
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: partner_overlap_matrix_v2.xlsx (Excel)]
[Attachment: SP-key-accounts-Q3.csv (CSV)]

From: Riley Chen <riley.chen@catalystworks.com>
To: priyom.das@redwood.com, priya.r@novaconsult.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Territory overlap: partner pipeline reconcile for StellarPay cluster

Hi Priyom —

Appreciate the flag. Quick answers from our side:

- Primary contact: Alonzo Vega, Head of Integrations (last call 2027-07-26)
- Planned scope: lead integration build + run (we own connector development and 90-day go-live support)
- Commercials: NDA in place, no LOI yet; we exchanged a statement of intent internally 7/22

We believe CatalystWorks brings a faster connector timeline (4–6 weeks) which is what StellarPay prioritized on our call. Happy to share our one-page tech brief and proposed SOW.

If Redwood prefers a single named partner, we can accept primary assignment. If dual-engagement is chosen, we request first right to propose the integration plan.

Best,
Riley Chen
Partnerships Lead, CatalystWorks
[Attachment referenced: CatalystWorks-SOW-onepager.pdf (sent on request)]

From: Priya Raman <priya.r@novaconsult.com>
To: priyom.das@redwood.com, riley.chen@catalystworks.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com, jonas.weber@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2027 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Territory overlap: partner pipeline reconcile for StellarPay cluster

Thanks Priyom —

Novaconsult confirms:
- Primary contact: Alonzo Vega (we met 7/14; follow-up demo 7/29)
- Planned scope: implementation + advisory for payments ops; we will hand connector build to CatalystWorks if they prefer to own dev work.
- Commercials: submitted a non-binding consulting proposal on 7/30; no signatures yet.

We'd prefer a dual-engagement where Nova handles ops/process and CatalystWorks does connector dev — that maps to our strengths. Open to arbitration if Redwood needs a single vendor.

- Priya
Senior Partner Manager, Nova Consulting

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: priyom.das@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com, jonas.weber@redwood.com
Cc: riley.chen@catalystworks.com, priya.r@novaconsult.com
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2027 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Territory overlap: partner pipeline reconcile for StellarPay cluster

Internal notes and constraints:

- Contracting: no standalone exclusivity with either partner in our Partner Program docs for mid-market.
- Marketplace listing: CatalystWorks is listed in our Integrations catalog; Nova is listed as a Consulting partner (distinct SKUs). So a scope split is feasible without breaking marketplace rules.
- Finance: SP-4571 is currently in discovery; no credits or MDF committed.

Recommendation (quick): Approve dual-engagement with explicit scope split — CatalystWorks owns connector dev + maintenance; Nova owns process redesign and post-launch change management. Require a short tri-party MOU that defines ownership of leads, billing contact, and support SLAs.

Action items:
1) Priyom: draft MOU template and circulate to both partners (due 8/3)
2) Jonas: check whether any marketplace listing terms require modification (ETA 8/4)
3) Marissa: hold a joint intro call with Alonzo and both partners to agree high-level timeline (schedule for 8/5)

Marissa Cole
Head of Partner GTM, Redwood Inference

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: riley.chen@catalystworks.com, priya.r@novaconsult.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com, jonas.weber@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 1 Aug 2027 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Territory overlap: partner pipeline reconcile for StellarPay cluster

Thanks everyone — quick update and next steps: 

- Per Marissa's recommendation, we're approving a dual-engagement with a narrow scope split (dev vs ops).
- I'm attaching the overlap matrix with a highlighted row for StellarPay; please review the MOU draft I'll send by EOD.
- Scheduling: proposed joint call Friday 8/5 at 10:30am PT (I'll send invite).

Riley / Priya: if you can both confirm availability for 8/5 and confirm the preferred billing contact for StellarPay (who Redwood should invoice or which partner will invoice), that will speed contracting.

Thanks —
Priyom
Senior Alliance Manager
Redwood Inference
